entries.what: Came off a double overtime night at Ridgeline and slept through the morning. With classes closed for the holiday he skipped the assigned Biomechanics reading entirely because he was too wiped to focus.
entries.outcome: Reading left undone, planned to catch up from Fatima's notes later in the week.

entries.what: Made chicken and rice at the Marisol Gardens apartment and hung out with Arjun before the evening ride to Ridgeline.
entries.outcome: Ate, packed his bag, left with Trevor at 8:15 p.m.

entries.what: Carpooled with Trevor in the Corolla for the 9 p.m. start of the ten-hour night shift on the cold dock.
entries.outcome: Shift started on time, $20 weekly gas covered.

entries.what: Fell behind rate on the cold dock during the night shift and got his first rate write-up from Carla, with José watching.
entries.outcome: One rate write-up went on file; a second would mean a final warning.

entries.what: Got home after the shift and vented to his assistant that Carla is unfair and plays favorites, then slept from about 8:30 a.m.
entries.outcome: Slept a few hours, still stewing.

entries.what: Woke up in the afternoon and ate eggs and rice, then Arjun offered advice about the write-up and Marcus brushed it off before heading to work.
entries.outcome: Tense but quick exchange, carpooled to Ridgeline.

entries.what: Slept after shift until midday, then took the Tule Line to Bayshore State for the 2 p.m. Wednesday section and the stats tutoring center at 12:30.
entries.outcome: Went through stats practice problems and borrowed Fatima's Biomechanics notes.

entries.what: Spent the evening cramming Biomechanics at the apartment before heading in for the night shift.
entries.outcome: Got through most of the notes.

entries.what: Worked the ten-hour night on the cold dock, 9 p.m. to 7:30 a.m., trying to stay above rate.
entries.outcome: Stayed on rate with no new write-up.

entries.what: Slept briefly after shift, then went to the Biomechanics midterm at Bayshore State on very little sleep.
entries.outcome: Finished the exam, unsure how it went.

entries.what: Caught up with Jade over text on the train home between classes, and she complained he'd been unreachable all week.
entries.outcome: Promised a call on Saturday.

entries.what: Took a quick nap, then carpooled in for the Thursday night shift.
entries.outcome: Clocked in at 9 p.m.

entries.what: Ridgeline payday. After shift he checked his balance and decided to raise the mom fund to $250 to cover Denise's electric bill, then asked his assistant how to word the Venmo note so she won't refuse it.
entries.outcome: Sent $250 with a casual note and she took it as a loan for her notebook.

entries.what: Slept until early afternoon, then went to Iron Flats Fitness for one of his two weekly lifts.
entries.outcome: Got through a lighter session on the 5/3/1 program.

entries.what: Heard from a coworker that the IT desk had a shake-up as Greg left and Victor was named acting lead.
entries.outcome: Nothing changed for him beyond needing a scanner swap.

entries.what: After a morning of rest, he bought a $240 sneaker release after the write-up week and asked his assistant how to flip them later, calling it an investment.
entries.outcome: Pair ordered, added to the box wall.

entries.what: Hit a Saturday morning gym session at Iron Flats before sleeping.
entries.outcome: Second lift of the week done.

entries.what: Saturday dinner with Jade at Phở Bến Thành, joking about vampire hours to ease her frustration.
entries.outcome: Good evening, she was less annoyed.

entries.what: Sunday meal prep of chicken and rice, five containers, and a quick call with his mom.
entries.outcome: Containers done for the week ahead.

entries.what: Studied for the Ex Phys midterm on Wednesday with Fatima's notes before getting ready for the night shift.
entries.outcome: Made a rough review plan.

entries.what: Carpooled with Trevor to Ridgeline for the Sunday night start of the week.
entries.outcome: Clocked in at 9 p.m.
